label: b46: c51 at n=4 -- batch 512, soft target, 21 / 201 atoms, one config a wave (vs b38)
notes:
WAVE 1'S CLOSE-OUT, RE-QUEUED BY HAND. The auto-spawned `b46-closeout` died at 19:16 on 2026-08-26,
2 seconds in, on `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'chart_viewer'` -- `vectorized/vec_wave.py`
lives in `snek2/vectorized/`, so Python seeds `sys.path[0]` with that directory and not the `snek2/`
above it, and the runner passes no PYTHONPATH. The scalar entry points sit IN `snek2/`, so this could
not happen until `vec_wave.py` became the desktop's default eval on 2026-08-24; b46's wave 1 was the
first close-out queued after that, so it was the first to hit it. Fixed by a `sys.path` bootstrap
inside both `vec_wave.py` and `vec_eval.py` -- reproduced with a scrubbed env, verified end to end,
three regression tests, all three mutations caught.

WHY A MANUAL SPEC AND NOT A RETRY. `_measured_policies` counts a `failed` wave as measured, on the
stated reasoning that "the reason is usually not transient" -- so all four b46a arms read as measured,
`_auto_closeout_jobs` skips them, and no `-w2` was ever synthesized. That is correct behaviour for the
general case and exactly wrong for this one, so the wave has to be asked for explicitly. The id ends in
`-closeout` deliberately: `_CLOSEOUT_ID_RE` is `-closeout(-w\d+)?$`, so once this runs
`_measured_policies` will cover these four policies and nothing will re-measure them. It is keyed on
`b46a` rather than `b46`, so it cannot collide with the `b46-closeout-w<k>` series the auto path hands
to waves 2-4.

PRIORITY 9, ONE AHEAD OF `AUTO_CLOSEOUT_PRIORITY` (10). Both sit well ahead of waves 3 and 4 (31/33),
so the wave barrier will run this the moment wave 2's training finishes, before any further training.
The 9 breaks the tie with wave 2's own auto close-out in favour of this one, which has been waiting
since 19:16.

ENV. `_auto_closeout_jobs` would have passed the arms' inherited env with disagreeing settings dropped;
they differ only in `SNEK_SEED`, which cannot reach a measurement of an already-trained checkpoint, so
this is that env verbatim minus the seed. `SNEK_FOOD_DISTANCE_REWARD=0` is the load-bearing one -- the
default is **0.001**, so leaving it out would silently change `avg_reward`.

WHAT IT MEASURES. `top50` over the four arms, `--chain` for the HOF re-measure as stage B. Expect stage
B to find nothing: 3M from scratch does not reach the >=98% band, so an empty HOF stage is the normal
outcome here and not a failure. Runs on the vec engine, so the rows are flat and ungated
(`min_achievable: null`) and directly poolable -- b38's rows were gated at 95, so compare via the
graph-100% tier or by re-reading each payload's gate.
